functions.description: Check that the patient age, sex, body weight, and serum creatinine are within the valid ranges for the Cockcroft-Gault equation and normalise the sex to female or male.
inputs: the age of the patient in years
the biological sex of the patient
the body weight of the patient in kilograms with unit
the serum creatinine concentration of the patient in mg/dL with unit
outputs: normalised sex as female or male

functions.description: Compute the base Cockcroft-Gault creatinine clearance before sex correction from age, body weight, and serum creatinine.
outputs: base creatinine clearance before sex correction in mL/min

functions.description: Apply the female sex correction factor of 0.85 to a base creatinine clearance for female patients, leaving the value unchanged for male patients.
inputs: normalised sex as female or male
base creatinine clearance before sex correction in mL/min

functions.description: Estimate the creatinine clearance of a patient using the Cockcroft-Gault equation from age, sex, body weight, and serum creatinine.
inputs: the age of the patient in years
the biological sex of the patient
the body weight of the patient in kilograms with unit
the serum creatinine concentration of the patient in mg/dL with unit

entry_points.text: Using the Cockcroft-Gault equation, estimate the creatinine clearance of a ●1-year-old ●2 who weighs ●3 and has a serum creatinine of ●4.

params.description: the age of the patient in years
params.validity_range: A positive whole number of years. The Cockcroft-Gault equation is validated for adults, so values below about 18 are outside its intended use. The term 140 minus age must stay positive, which requires age below 140, so the valid range is roughly 18 to 110.

params.description: the biological sex of the patient
params.validity_range: Must be either male or female. The equation applies a multiplicative correction of 0.85 for female patients and none for male patients, so the value must map unambiguously to one of these two categories.

params.description: the body weight of the patient in kilograms with unit
params.validity_range: A positive real number in kilograms. Physically plausible adult weights are roughly 30 to 250 kg. Weight enters the numerator linearly, so it must be greater than zero.

params.description: the serum creatinine concentration of the patient in mg/dL with unit
params.validity_range: A strictly positive real number in mg/dL, because serum creatinine is the divisor in the equation and zero or negative values are undefined. Clinically plausible values are roughly 0.2 to 15 mg/dL.
